title: Senior Technical Solution Owner – Cornerstone Application & Integrations

titleByLocale.en: Senior Technical Solution Owner – Cornerstone Application & Integrations
titleByLocale.de: Senior Technical Solution Owner – Cornerstone Application & Integrations
titleByLocale.fr: Propriétaire principal de la solution technique – Application et intégration de Cornerstone

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Senior Technical Solution Owner – Cornerstone Application & Integration serves as the ultimate technical authority for our Cornerstone platform as a core enterprise solution supporting learning, talent, and people development processes. You are the “subject matter expert”, responsible for technical integrity, exploiting Cornerstones functionalities maximising the platform's business value while ensuring technical stability. This role provides clear ownership of the technical realization and integration ecosystem, leading data migration initiatives, with a strong outcome oriented mindset and ability to translate requirements into acceptance criteria and ensure successful solution delivery. In this role, you serve as a high-level sparring partner to other seniors IT stakeholders, contributing with your deep-dive Cornerstone expertise. You bridge the gap between business requirements and technical execution, ensuring that every integration - whether upstream from Core HR or to downstream systems - is seamless, scalable, and robust. Your span of control ranges from license management, platform performance and stability, compliance and audit readiness, release feature prioritization, to driving medium- to large-scale initiatives that enhance the value, adoption, and impact of the platform. As a senior leader in this space, you shape the technical evolution of the Cornerstone platform based on business priorities and the platform’s technical dept, guide decision-making delivering respective change impact assessments, and ensure that platform capabilities are translated into meaningful business outcomes. You work closely with business stakeholders, product and technical teams, architects, and external partners to ensure the solution is scalable, user-centered, and fit for purpose. With your in depth Cornerstone expertise and your learning process acumen, you understand the context of changes and how they relate to business needs to proactively shape the learning landscape. This role goes beyond operational delivery. It requires a strong understanding of stakeholder ecosystems, enterprise platforms, and business transformation, with a particular focus on ensuring that Cornerstone capabilities are aligned to strategic priorities, integrated into end-to-end people processes, and optimized to deliver measurable value . Key Responsibilities Audit & Compliance
• Validation & Audits : Ensure fully documented and validated system including change control and ensure compliant change administration on GXP application. Orchestrate audits and periodic reviews to ensure compliance resolving respective findings.
• Security & Access Control: Oversee tenant access, and perform Cornerstone account reviews, oversee and control access provisioning. Accountable for access provisioning, training assignment and training completion of workforce operating and using Cornerstone platform.
• Documentation : Lead delivery and regular update of Data Migration Plans, Operational Support Plans and Information Risk Assessment and Mitigation System documents such as security risk assessments, data processing agreements. Technical Solution Ownership
• Functional Design & Innovation : Evaluate Cornerstone features, platform developments and integration requests to provide expert recommendations on how to simplify, harmonize, and innovate people-processes through technical enablement, understanding overall business change impact. Ensure the solution design supports end-to-end business process
